# Property bindings the engine's C++ reads from script objects.
#
# List only properties C++ actually reads. Every entry is checked against the
# loaded packages, so an unused one only stops modded packages from loading,
# packages the original engine would load because it never relied on that layout.
#
# `ucc genprops src/engine/props_bindings.txt src/engine` regenerates
# src/engine/props_<file>.h and .cc from this list and the loaded packages.
# The generated files are checked in; regenerate after editing this list.
#
# Each property's type, element size and array length come from the loaded
# package. A script struct gets a typed accessor only when it has a C++
# mirror below; any other struct gets a raw uint8_t* accessor.
#
#   mirror <script struct> <C++ type>
#   file <name>                        starts props_<name>.h/.cc
#   class <Package.Class> [as <ns>]    namespace defaults to the lowercase class name
#       <Property> [optional]          optional: the package may lack it
#
# Each generated entry records the kind, element size and array length its
# accessor assumes; bindAllProps (src/engine/props_bind.h) checks them against
# the loaded property at startup and after an editor compile, and fails on a
# missing class, a missing required property or any mismatch. An optional
# property the package lacks binds as PropAbsent and its accessor returns a
# pointer that is null then; required accessors return references.

mirror Vector Vector
mirror Rotator Rotator
mirror Color Color
mirror Plane Plane
mirror Coords Coords
